description: This file defines tracing categories and related utility classes for the WPEFramework project, including formatting, text handling, and various trace message classes.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: A utility class for managing and formatting text strings, supporting various constructors and setting methods.

classes.name: Constructor
classes.description: Represents a generic constructor message with string data.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a destructor message with string data.

classes.name: CopyConstructor
classes.description: Represents a copy constructor message with string data.

classes.name: AssignmentOperator
classes.description: Represents an assignment operator message with string data.

classes.name: MethodEntry
classes.description: Logs entry into a method, capturing the method name.

classes.name: MethodExit
classes.description: Logs exit from a method, capturing the method name.

classes.name: Fatal
classes.description: Represents a fatal error trace message.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Measures and logs the duration between a start time and the current time.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: A variadic template function for formatting strings, for backwards compatibility.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: A variadic template function returning a formatted string, for backwards compatibility.
